subject: Require message-board state to accompany project pushes to GitHub
summary: From this bootstrap forward, any push or pull request that changes project state must include a committed update under artifactory/message_board/. The board is canonical GitHub-tracked state. A GitHub Actions guard fails synchronization checks when a push or pull request contains no board update. Because main was unprotected at bootstrap time, this is CI detection/enforcement rather than a server-side hard block until branch protection or a ruleset requires the check.
